The FPV CapEx Tool: A Floating Solar Specific Heuristics Tool to Determine the Investments Required for Utility-scale Solar To estimate the CapEx for utility-scale FPV projects, a heuristic analysis was used by examining data from currently deployed projects. This approach leverages real-world trends and projects deployed in the U.S. to derive cost estimates that can be applied to similar future projects in the U.S. with capacities ranging from 1–100 MW .
